title: PayoutsAccountCheckPassedPayload
description: Payload of `payouts.account_check.passed` version 1. A payout destination passed its one-rupee check: the payout provider sent ₹1.00, which stays with the holder, and the bank returned the holder's legal name; or platform staff checked it by hand with a reason. A statement held for it is due without the hold at once. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

holder_kind.description: Whose destination: a Partner's payout account, or a platform fleet Agent's.

partner_id.description: The Partner, or the Agent's Partner; the envelope's `partner_id` too.

agent_id.description: The Agent membership, for an Agent's destination.

destination_last4.description: The bank account's last four digits, or the last four characters of the UPI ID's handle.

reference.description: The payout provider's reference for the ₹1.00 transfer; `null` when checked by hand.

by.description: Who decided: the `provider`, or `staff` by hand.

money.description: An amount in minor units with its ISO 4217 currency.

minor_units.description: The amount in the currency's minor unit.
